_comment: 34-day rotating astrology topic calendar (cycles roughly monthly via day-of-year modulo — see generate_topic_assets.py:_load_topic). Claude writes a FRESH script each time, so even a repeated topic gets new content month to month. Reorder/edit freely. Days 32-34 (political/stockmarket/crypto) are deliberately evergreen/historical/educational — never real-time election or trading predictions; see their angle text.
